title: Brazil’s Lula gears up for ‘last dance’ with run for fourth presidential term
summary: President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva will stand for re-election in Brazil on Sunday. At 80, the former steelworker hopes to capitalise on his popularity and economic successes to win a fourth term in office but is neck-and-neck in the polls with far-right rival Flavio Bolsonaro.
author: Guido BURDMAN
